title: The Tofu Interconnect D
version: IEEE CLUSTER 2018, pp. 646–654, doi:10.1109/CLUSTER.2018.00090, author-hosted PDF

passages.note: The designers identify K as the original Tofu system and FX10 as another implementation. They identify Tofu2 as the next version and PRIMEHPC FX100 as its 2015 system. Table I compares the three generations. TofuD's design and evaluation cover denser node implementation, communications resources and fault resilience.
